messages:
lauren-sales: FinServCo wants to run a 3-month POC. Requirement: all inference data must remain in EU (no egress to US). They need the EU sub-processor list, confirmation we can pin region + block fallbacks to non-EU models, and a rough Dedicated-EU POC pricing. Any immediate blockers? cc @rowan-ps

julie-sales: They said scale is small — ~10 req/s steady, bursts to 50 for a few mins. Procurement wants answers by EOD Friday.

matt-eng: Short answer: we can enforce EU-only routing for requests. Caveat: some large models are only hosted in NA; we should offer EU-hosted open models or quantized EU variants for the POC. I'll inventory model availability and fallback behavior today. @ana-security fyi on subprocessors.

rowan-ps: We can stand up a Dedicated EU tenant for a 3-month POC. Ballpark pricing for small reserved pool: ~€9k–12k/month depending on GPU class and burst policy. If they want SLA and strict isolation add-on, +€2k/mo. I'll firm numbers after Matt confirms GPU/memory needs.

ana-security: Current EU sub-processor inventory (short):
```
- Cloud: GCP (europe-west1)
- Hosting partner: Hetzner (DE)
- CDN/edge: KeyCDN (EU nodes)
- Logging: LogSafe (EU cluster)
- Monitoring/metrics: MetricsCo (EU region)
- Secrets/KMS: customer-managed KMS preferred; we support GCP KMS + external HSM connectors
```
We also have DPA & SCCs ready; will attach export. Note: if customer requires all cryptographic material to never leave their HSM, that pushes to Private offering.

matt-eng: Example routing/policy snippet we can apply for the POC (config we use in the platform):
```yaml
routing_policy:
  region_allowlist: ["eu-west-1","europe-west2"]
  deny_fallback_regions: true   # prevents automatic fallback to non-EU
  model_pin:
    preferred: ["redwood-open-7b-eu","gptq-6b-eu"]
    fallback: []                # empty => no cross-region fallback
  kv_cache_location: "eu-west-1"
```
This will ensure KV/cache and inference stay in EU. If they need a model we don't host in EU, we must either provide a quantized EU copy or move to Private.

deploy-bot: :robot_face: Canary job scheduled: deploy/redwood-eu-poc-config -> eu cluster at 2026-06-01T12:00Z (dry run).

lauren-sales: Two asks from me: (1) formal subprocessor export + DPA excerpt for procurement, (2) final pricing sheet and one-pager by Friday. Who owns each?

rowan-ps: I'll own pricing and the POC runbook (topology, SLOs, cost splits). Will produce a 1-pager + itemized quote by Thu COB. @ana-security can you attach the formal subproc doc?

ana-security: On it — will drop the export and DPA excerpt to the sales drive and link it here. Quick caution: if FinServCo's legal insists on no third-party analytics vendors, we can disable MetricsCo and run internal metrics in EU-only mode, but that increases ops cost (call out in quote).

lauren-sales: Customer said managed by Redwood is fine as long as traffic never leaves EU. I'll confirm and escalate if they request on-prem. Thanks everyone.

julie-sales: Awesome, thanks team :thumbsup:
